explanations: Finalists were recalculated through the complete build calculator.
Known set effects were included.
Set bonus active: Chaos Harbinger at 2 pieces (6/6 equipped).
Set bonus active: Chaos Harbinger at 4 pieces (6/6 equipped).
Set bonus active: Chaos Harbinger at 6 pieces (6/6 equipped).

Heroic Calanthia's Spire of Torment: Effect 1: Critical Hit Chance +400 — feeds #2 PvP Magic Critical Hit Chance; alternatives: Strength +20, Dexterity +20, Wisdom +20. Effect 2: Magic Critical Hit Chance +400 — feeds #2 PvP Magic Critical Hit Chance; alternatives: Strength +20, Dexterity +20, Wisdom +20.

Heroic Calanthia's Confession: Effect 1: Critical Hit Chance +220 — feeds #2 PvP Magic Critical Hit Chance; alternatives: Damage Reduction +66, Bonus Damage +66, Attack Range +22%. Effect 2: Hit Chance +220 — improves no ranked goal; kept as a deterministic tie-breaker; alternatives: Damage Reduction +66, Bonus Damage +66, Attack Range +22%. Effect 3: Endurance +220 — improves no ranked goal; kept as a deterministic tie-breaker; alternatives: Damage Reduction +66, Bonus Damage +66, Attack Range +22%.

Heroic Choking Conviction: Effect 1: Dexterity +11 — improves no ranked goal; kept as a deterministic tie-breaker; alternatives: Wisdom +11, Perception +11, Fortitude +11. Effect 2: Attack Speed +14.4% — feeds #4 Attack Speed; alternatives: Dexterity +11, Wisdom +11, Perception +11. Effect 3: Cooldown Speed +11% — feeds #5 Cooldown Speed; alternatives: Dexterity +11, Wisdom +11, Perception +11.
Main Hand: Attack Assist Defense supplies +4 Dexterity toward attribute milestones.
Off Hand: Attack Assist Defense supplies +4 Dexterity toward attribute milestones.
Legs: Attack Assist Defense supplies +2 Wisdom toward attribute milestones.
Necklace: Assist Attack Defense supplies +3 Dexterity toward attribute milestones.
Ring 1: Assist Attack Defense supplies +3 Strength toward attribute milestones.
Ring 2: Assist Attack Defense supplies +3 Strength toward attribute milestones.
Earring: Assist Attack Defense supplies +3 Fortitude toward attribute milestones.
Skill Damage Boost: 6050 at priority 1; normalized contribution +0.178.
PvP Magic Critical Hit Chance: 62982 at priority 2; normalized contribution +2.888.
Critical Damage: 6250 at priority 3; normalized contribution +0.047.
Attack Speed: 10760 at priority 4; normalized contribution +0.006.
Cooldown Speed: 8240 at priority 5; normalized contribution +0.002.
No selected goal finished below the fixed objective baseline.
assumptions: Item Potentials are excluded from calculations and recommendations in this release; same-item selections are preserved.
59 available attribute points were redistributed across STR, DEX, INT, PER, and CON.
This is a theoretical catalogue build. Ownership and acquisition cost are not scored.
Eight passive skills were selected at up to level 20.
Staff mastery uses 220 of 220 available points.
Dagger mastery uses 220 of 220 available points.
Only decoded-proven persistent Skill Cores are optimized; conditional or unsupported cores receive no invented static value.
The game allows repeated Equipment Skills, but exact scoring activates only one copy in the current fixed-level catalogue.
Exactly three normal rune sockets are considered; normal rune rows may repeat.
No more than one Chaos rune is used per item.
warnings: This is a bounded search, so the result is the best loadout found rather than proof of the mathematical global optimum.
